requirement_summary: 02_FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_PROGRAMS.md FR-COM-006: 'ONSure 내부 오류에 의한 실패는 고객 사용량으로 확정하지 않는다.'
subject: SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.usageAttributionCheck via assurance.usage.attribution-check; contracts/usage-attribution-check.v1.schema.json (NEW)
coverage_notes: usageAttributionCheckNeverCountsAnInternalErrorAsUsageEvenIfClaimed is the direct test of the requirement: usage_countable is computed purely from failure_cause, not read from the caller's claimed_usage_countable field, so a caller cannot simply assert INTERNAL_ERROR failures as billable usage -- the mismatch is surfaced (usage_verified=false) rather than silently accepted. usageAttributionCheckCountsACustomerInputErrorAsUsage proves the requirement's carve-out is narrow and specific to INTERNAL_ERROR: a customer-caused failure is legitimately usage-countable, so this operation does not over-broadly exempt every failure type, only the one the requirement names.
open_gap: Operates on a caller-supplied failure_cause classification; there is no live billing/metering runtime in this codebase that actually classifies a real execution failure into one of these 5 categories and feeds this gate from real system state (same disclosed 'caller-supplied representation, not live system integration' pattern as every other real-computation closure this session). The requirement's classification of what genuinely constitutes an 'ONSure 내부 오류' versus the other 4 categories is this closure's own disclosed enum choice, not a literal identifier the requirement text itself defines.
